runtime_notes: GitHub Actions Capture Eval 01 (run 33202431954, job 98954942239) built the frozen Vue 3 + Element Plus 2.9.5 fixture at commit a8e4b341f36662c8f86c4e5306654e3b2cdd4f73, served vite preview on :4173, and captured desktop 1440x1000 plus mobile 390x844. metrics.json reports evidenceLevel rendered-ci, no console/page errors, no page-level overflow, table visible, Tab focus on Export with 2px solid outline, detailMode inline-preview. After row click, desktop keeps the table beside a 340px preview pane; mobile hides the list, shows the preview, and exposes .mobile-back. Capture hardFailures array was empty.
keyboard_notes: Tab from load lands on the Export button with a 2px solid focus outline. Search, status, date, bulk buttons, and table checkboxes are Element Plus and remain keyboard-operable. Row inspection is pointer-only: AppTable is a thin ElTable wrapper with @row-click and no row tabIndex / Enter-Space handler, and the preview pane has no keyboard next/prev. This misses the fixture contract that row inspection stay keyboard-operable and the master-detail-preview interaction (keyboard-next-prev, escape-close). Recorded as accessibility-failure, not a hard fail, because primary toolbar/filter/bulk controls are still operable and capture Tab succeeded.
reduced_motion_notes: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce emulation matched. Composition uses CSS layout and Vue class toggles for list-then-detail; no extra motion library and no decorative animation stack.
review_notes: Scored from CI-rendered screenshots and metrics, plus source review of OrdersBaseline.vue / AppTable.vue / App.vue at a8e4b341. Composition matches the expected skeleton: dense filter toolbar with live count, collection pane + 340px detail pane, sticky bulk bar scoped to selection, loading/empty/error states, and a deliberate mobile list-then-detail (empty preview pane hidden until a row is chosen; Back returns to the list). Host tokens and Element Plus wrappers are reused; no Tailwind/Radix/shadcn/second table library; package.json unchanged. view-options-control was a case candidate and was not implemented — not scored as a decision error because it is optional. Main remaining gap is row-level keyboard inspection. Not a hard fail: it builds, keeps the host primitive system, has no severe overflow, and primary toolbar controls are accessible.
